description: SunPeek is a web and Python system for assessing the performance of large solar-thermal collector fields. It ingests and cleans plant measurements, models expected output using an ISO 24194 power-check method, then creates plots and reports for operators. Its geographic coverage and time span follow the plant and measurements supplied; the software is distinct from its example open dataset. The current GitLab backend declares LGPL-3.0-only in pyproject.toml, while the JOSS availability section identifies BSD-3-Clause for the separate web interface. It can help test solar-heat performance assumptions in district-heating or industrial-heat simulations. A caveat is that a power-check result depends on sensor quality and collector parameters; it does not validate every heat-network component. The related catalogue data-solar-process-heat-plants-izmir-condat-monitoring covers two public plant datasets, not this software. The own GitLab project and JOSS article were read without deploying the service or downloading data.
name: SunPeek solar-thermal performance analytics
